macos-launchctl v1.0.0 — First Release

- Initial release for managing macOS app timed launch/quit tasks via launchctl and launchd.
- Supports natural language scheduling ("daily at 9 AM", "Weekly on Monday at 8:00", cron expression).
- Automatically generates and loads launchd plist files for scheduled start/stop of apps.
- Command line script with create/list/start/stop/restart/remove/info/status subcommands.
- Safety-first: Operations require clear user preview and explicit confirmation before any write/load/remove action.
- Supports dry-run preview of task plan and generated plist files to ensure full transparency.
